scope: The reviewed gameplan coherently resolves this seat's initial nominal-slot, palette, keyboard operation, accepted/draft, source freshness, 500-node and style planning findings. This is design-plan approval only. Final exact-hash council approval and two clean registered formal builds remain prerequisites to production work. No browser, performance, accessibility, full formal refinement or G2/G3 acceptance is asserted. The changing formal model and known raw-decoder/restore-zero/policy issues are outside this targeted follow-up review.

resolved_initial_findings.assessment: Closed declarations and all23 expression tags now specify exact roles, arity, ordered nominal schemas, field owner/range and multiplicity restrictions, set-valued parameters and command targets/options. UI explicitly exposes unresolved sibling/join constraints rather than inventing types; completion independently checks whole module.

Pointer and keyboard create/connect/copy/cut/paste/move/delete/history operations, fresh copied binder IDs, preserved moved IDs, destination scope checks, descendant denial, focus behavior, visible actions and native text-input shortcut exclusions are planned. Named Firefox ESR/Orca and Chromium scenarios remain actual execution obligations.

Separate accepted receipt/read state, immutable draft identity/epoch, exact retry bytes, retained rejected drafts and monotone accepted revision address the browser-local commit problem. Late success updates knowledge without overwriting a newer draft. History-copy uses explicit targets and new revisions with unsaved-draft preview.

Unique ownership forest removes scope-dependent sharing. Artifact/source-bound node-role occurrences, explicit presentation envelope, strict Unicode, activation-time freshness checks, exact authored source and explicit comment transfer/orphans provide a coherent projection plan.

The plan preserves formal-before-production order and explicitly limits proof claims. Current changing model is not approved by this UX review; final exact proposition and hash review remains required.

512-node cap retains the inherited500-node fixture rather than reducing it to256. Depth32/source32768 are explicit bounds, not latency evidence. Warm local-server1000-edit p50/p95/p99 benchmark, separate solver timing, actual launcher constraints and existing Java/JS/TS source/test/callback style requirements remain binding.

bounded_clarifications_for_final_freeze.topic: Copying an already edited or fresh draft subtree
bounded_clarifications_for_final_freeze.evidence: UI copy says presentationCopies attaches each old expression to a new expression; wire permits sourceNodeId only from exact accepted base and targets only fresh draft IDs. A user can copy a new draft expression or copy a previously pasted expression before any save.
bounded_clarifications_for_final_freeze.resolution: State that browser clipboard retains optional accepted-base comment provenance per node, separate from semantic IDs. Copying draft-only content with no base comment provenance emits no transfer entry. Recopying a pasted node may propagate its original accepted-base source ID to a new unique destination; never send a draft ID as sourceNodeId. A baseRevision change requires explicit provenance rebasing or clearing with a visible notice, never guessing by text. Add tests for fresh-draft copy, copy-of-copy before save, modified copy and base refresh. The wire comment-only authority is sufficient; no new semantic copy endpoint is needed.

bounded_clarifications_for_final_freeze.topic: Cut/copy payload lifetime with selection epochs
bounded_clarifications_for_final_freeze.evidence: Payload binds draft epoch, while choosing a destination necessarily changes selection and increments that epoch. Applying strict equality to the original clipboard epoch on Paste would make ordinary keyboard Cut/Copy then select-destination then Paste unusable.
bounded_clarifications_for_final_freeze.resolution: Define a separate immutable content-generation or source-snapshot marker for clipboard validity. Keep presentation epoch increments for selection/freshness, but permit destination selection changes while verifying the source node/content/base is unchanged. Alternatively explicitly advance a pending clipboard token through selection-only transitions. Any actual source mutation, source deletion, accepted-base change or document switch invalidates/rechecks the token. Tests must exercise real Copy/Cut, destination selection and Paste, plus a source edit between those steps. No relaxation of diagnostic/evidence epoch matching follows.

bounded_clarifications_for_final_freeze.topic: Deterministic history navigation and benchmark definition
bounded_clarifications_for_final_freeze.resolution: History buttons should identify their exact target revision/artifact in a visible preview; after a history-copy commit keep the explicitly selected navigation cursor distinct from latest head so Redo cannot infer an inverse from global state. Freeze the deterministic500-expression fixture, edit sequence, warmup count, server/browser timing endpoints and command-independent preview path before measurements. Source hashes, UUIDs, schema width and declaration limits must remain valid for the fixture. These are test-plan details, not evidence presently obtained.

required_execution_matrix: Every palette tag/declaration: valid construction plus known nominal mismatch, arity/direction, unknown binding, dependency invalidation and server-side forged request denial; include partial constraints with holes and no accepted-save authority.

Actual browser keyboard and pointer copy/move including nested quantifiers, fresh/internal remapping, external references, descendant denial, ordinary destination selection, draft-only copy, comment copy-of-copy, rejection focus and live announcements.

Actual API/persistence accepted-state tests: concurrent revisions, lost acknowledgement, exact-byte retry, restart, full quota existing receipt, history-copy under current policy and unchanged accepted artifact on known rejection. Then browser delayed-success/newer-draft tests.

Source/mode/map fixtures: repeated expressions, nested spans, tabs/EOF, supplementary and combining Unicode, CRLF, invalid surrogate denial, comments/orphans, SOURCE/BLOCK_SUPPORTED/TEXT_ONLY transitions and stale activation after selection or edit.

Automated accessibility plus recorded named manual Firefox ESR/Orca and Chromium keyboard scenarios; report exact versions and observed outcomes. Unit/component helper success cannot replace this evidence.

Reference-host500-node/1000-edit latency samples with p50/p95/p99 and warmup defined; actual bounded worker startup/resource checks; existing AST documentation/private-state/30-line guards across all authored source and tests. Report unmet thresholds rather than silently reducing fixture.

Preserve independently required canonical proof checker, Lean-oracle Java/certificate differential tests and complete versus budget-limited profile distinctions. Plan approval does not close these original G3 items.
